summary.guide: Partner Learning Center /partners/docs, "EPCIS Event Reporting Standards — Technical Onboarding Guide" v0.3 (Technical Guides) + Test Execution step + Swagger /api/partner-docs-json
summary.note: Guide content is identical for all four organisation types. Each rule was tested in JSON-LD (short tokens) and EPCIS 1.2 XML (full URNs) wherever both apply. Product: Amtel urn:epc:id:sgtin:8904179.170218.*
formatInconsistencies: errorDeclaration invalid reason: JSON-LD 400 vs XML 500
incorrect_data without correctiveEventIDs: JSON-LD 400 vs XML 202 + INCOMPLETE_ERROR_DECLARATION
UNKNOWN_PARTY_GLN is raised only for XML source/destination lists, never for identical JSON-LD

rules.section: §1.3, §3.3.2 + examples "EPCIS 1.2 XML/2.0 JSON-LD – Facility Unpack"
rules.rule: Facility unpack (AggregationEvent DELETE, bizStep unpacking) is a documented facility event with examples
rules.live: Facility key, unpacking, both formats (matrix; docexamples #24/#25; chains FUNPK) -> 403 PARTNER_TYPE_BIZSTEP_MISMATCH "facility is not allowed to submit bizStep unpacking"
rules.likelyWrong: Either. Guide is internally inconsistent (§1.3 omits Unpack for facilities but §3.3.2 and two examples document it). Product decision needed; most likely a missing system permission because facilities do break cases before dispensing.

rules.section: §1.3 (Recall–Destruction for Manufacturer & Distributor), §4.3.1, TC-SPE-01 "ALL ROLES … 202"
rules.rule: Recall Initiation (holding/recalled) can be submitted, expected 202
rules.live: holding/recalled with manufacturer, distributor and facility keys, both formats, and both guide Recall examples -> 403 PARTNER_TYPE_BIZSTEP_MISMATCH for all 3 roles
rules.likelyWrong: Docs bug (TC-SPE-01, §1.3). §4.3.1 itself calls recall a regulatory action; the system restricts it to the regulator. Consequence: RECALL_ACTIVE, recall override and recall->destroy flows cannot be certified by partners.

rules.section: Appendix B "in_transit -> inactive  Lost products"; §4.4.2.2
rules.rule: Lost is allowed from in_transit (the only Lost row in the matrix)
rules.live: in_transit SGTIN -> decommissioning/inactive: 202 + INVALID_DISPOSITION "in_transit → inactive is not allowed" (chains SX-lostT, both formats). active -> inactive is accepted with no flag (SX-lostA)
rules.likelyWrong: System bug: the rule engine has this transition the wrong way round compared with the matrix.

rules.section: §4.4.4 Export: "prior disposition should be active or in_transit"
rules.rule: Export (decommissioning/non_sellable_other) is allowed from active and in_transit
rules.live: active -> non_sellable_other and in_transit -> non_sellable_other: 202 + INVALID_DISPOSITION "… is not allowed" (SX-export, SX-exportT, both formats)
rules.likelyWrong: System bug: the transition is missing from the rule engine. Appendix B also omits Export, so update the matrix too.

rules.section: §4.4.3 Expired: "prior disposition should be active or in_transit"
rules.live: in_transit -> expired: 202 + INVALID_DISPOSITION "in_transit → expired is not allowed" (SX-expT, both formats). active -> expired is clean.
rules.likelyWrong: System bug, most likely: the rule engine copies Appendix B, which lists only active->expired. Fix the matrix as well.

rules.section: §4.2.2 Return Receiving; Appendix D "receiving / returned – holding state pending QA review"
rules.rule: Return receiving may use disposition returned
rules.live: Return-receive of an SGTIN that was return-shipped (returned) with disposition returned: 202 + INVALID_DISPOSITION "returned → returned is not allowed" (RET-rcv1, both formats). Receiving with disposition active is clean.
rules.likelyWrong: System bug

rules.section: §4.3.2 "Attempting to destroy an active or in_transit EPC without prior status change is flagged with INVALID_DISPOSITION"; TC-SPE-03 DESTRUCTION_WITHOUT_RECALL 201⚠
rules.rule: Destroying an active EPC is flagged
rules.live: active SGTIN -> destroying/destroyed: 202, no flag at all (SX-destroyA, both formats)
rules.likelyWrong: System bug. Also, DESTRUCTION_WITHOUT_RECALL does not exist in the §6.1 tables, so the docs should use one code.

rules.section: §3.3.3 "Prior disposition of each SGTIN must be active. Dispensing from other states generates INVALID_DISPOSITION"; Swagger dispense: "dispensing a recalled/expired/destroyed serial returns INVALID_DISPOSITION"
rules.rule: Dispensing non-active serials is flagged or rejected
rules.live: POST /facility/events/dispense of damaged, expired, in_transit and past-expiry SGTINs -> 201 with no warnings (SX-dispDmg, SX-dispExp, SX-dispTransit, SX-dispExpProd, both formats). The in_transit unit was then recorded as dispensed (a later receive was flagged "dispensed → active").
rules.likelyWrong: System bug, critical for patient safety: the synchronous dispense path runs no disposition or expiry rules.

rules.section: §6.1.2 flag table (UNKNOWN_SGTIN, STALE_EVENT_TIME, SSCC_AT_DISPENSING); Swagger "SSCC_AT_DISPENSING is returned in warnings / flagged_events"; cert. case "3.3.3 unknown SGTIN -> 201 with UNKNOWN_SGTIN warning"
rules.live: Every dispense 201 response is {event_id, epcs_processed, class_level, _sandbox} with no warnings key. Unknown SGTIN, unregistered product, SSCC in epcList and an 8-day-old eventTime all give a bare 201 (DSP-unknown, DSP-unregprod, DSP-ssc, DSP-stale). The same dispensing event POSTed to /facility/events returns UNKNOWN_SGTIN (DSP-viaEvents).
rules.likelyWrong: System bug: the sync path skips the layer-3 rule engine or drops its warnings. Note: the "3.3.3 unknown SGTIN" certification text is not in the live guide; it is probably in the Test Scenarios PDF, whose link returns 404.

rules.section: TC-FAC-05 "expect flag ALREADY_DISPENSED" (400); §6.1.2 SERIAL_ALREADY_DISPENSED (flag)
rules.rule: Re-dispensing a dispensed serial gives ALREADY_DISPENSED / SERIAL_ALREADY_DISPENSED
rules.live: Second dispense of the same SGTIN, with a new eventID and either the same or a different eventTime -> 409 DUPLICATE_EVENT_PAYLOAD "Duplicate matrix key EPC+bizStep" (DSP-again-*, both formats)
rules.likelyWrong: Both sides. The docs contradict themselves (400 vs flag, two code names). The system answers with generic dedupe, so the business rule never fires. Choose one code and status, then align.

rules.section: TC-FAC-06 "expect flag DISPENSING_WITHOUT_RECEIVING 201⚠"
rules.rule: Dispensing without a prior facility receipt is flagged
rules.live: Dispense of SGTINs that are active at the manufacturer and were never received by the facility -> 201, no warning (SX-disp)
rules.likelyWrong: System, plus docs: the code is absent from the §6.1 tables and the dispense path returns no warnings at all.

rules.section: §3.3.3 "Only SGTINs are allowed in epcList (no SSCC at dispensing)"
rules.rule: An SSCC in a dispense epcList is not allowed (the flag table says advisory SSCC_AT_DISPENSING)
rules.live: Dispense with an SSCC -> 201, no warning (DSP-ssc, both formats)
rules.likelyWrong: System (no advisory). The docs also contradict themselves: "not allowed" vs "advisory only".

rules.section: §2.6 / §5-6 constraints / §6.1.1 MESSAGE_SIZE_EXCEEDED / Swagger: dispense max 1 MB -> 413; TC-CON-02: >500 KB dispense or >1 MB async -> 413
rules.live: Dispense 600 KB -> 201; dispense 1.1 MB -> 201; async 1.5 MB -> 202 (SIZE-*). 10 MB was not tested.
rules.likelyWrong: System bug for the dispense 1 MB limit. Docs bug for TC-CON-02 (500 KB and 1 MB async contradict §2.6, which says 1 MB and 10 MB).

rules.section: §3.2.2 "Partial unpack is allowed … children revert to active"; §3.3.2 "Full unpack permitted"; TC-DIS-03/04
rules.rule: Unpacking an SGTIN from an SSCC detaches it and allows repacking
rules.live: Clean retest after ship+receive: partial unpack C->[S0] and full unpack C3->[S6,S7] -> 202 + INVALID_PARENT_CHILD_RELATION "not an active child of parent C" (both formats). Then repacking S0 -> CHILD_ALREADY_AGGREGATED "already in active aggregation (case_sscc=C)", and shipping S6 -> INVALID_PARENT_CHILD_RELATION "is a child of SSCC C3" (retest R-*). Unpacking an SSCC from a pallet works cleanly (chains UNPK-partial).
rules.likelyWrong: System bug: the unpack validator and the aggregation store disagree, and SGTIN children stay aggregated.

rules.section: §3.1.2/§3.2.3 "SSCC is first used as parentID in an AggregationEvent (not pre-commissioned separately)"
rules.rule: Packing into a brand-new SSCC is valid and unflagged
rules.live: Every pack into a new SSCC (case, pallet, docs examples) -> 202 + PARENT_NOT_FOUND "has no active case_package_history row" (PK-1..3, PAL, R-pack*, docexamples)
rules.likelyWrong: System bug: a false positive on the documented happy path, so partners cannot tell real errors from noise.

rules.section: §3.2.1/§3.3.1 "the platform validates the receiver's GLN against the prior shipment's destinationList"; "A receiving event from a party not listed as the prior destination should generate the same compliance warning"; sourceList "must match the prior shipping event's sourceList"
rules.rule: Receiving at the wrong GLN, or from the wrong sender, is flagged
rules.live: Clean retest: SGTIN shipped to 0123456.22222.0 and received at 0123456.11111.0 -> 202, no flag (R-rcvWrongGLN, both formats). Received naming a sender other than the shipper -> 202, no flag (RCV-wrongSrc).
rules.likelyWrong: System bug

rules.section: §3.2.1 "A receiving event for an EPC not previously in_transit yields RECEIVING_WITHOUT_SHIPPING"; §4.2.2 mismatches generate RECEIVING_WITHOUT_SHIPPING
rules.rule: Receiving a never-shipped EPC is flagged
rules.live: Works for SGTINs (RCV-noShip, matrix). Receiving an SSCC that was packed but never shipped -> 202, no flag (R-rcvSSCCnoShip). Receiving unknown SSCCs in the guide's Receiving and Return Receiving examples is also unflagged.
rules.likelyWrong: System bug (SSCC path)

rules.section: §2.6.3 "bizTransactionList is mandatory on all shipment and receiving events … absence is a validation error"; §3.1.4/§3.2.1/§3.3.1 "mandatory"
rules.rule: Shipping and receiving without bizTransactionList are rejected or flagged
rules.live: Shipping without BTT -> 202 (SHP-noBTT); receiving without BTT -> 202 (RCV-noBTT); no flag in either format
rules.likelyWrong: System (missing check), or downgrade the docs wording. The docs also contradict themselves: §2.6.3 says "mandatory on all events", yet the Lost and Commissioning examples have no BTT.

rules.section: §3.1.4 "disposition must be in_transit"; "destinationList must include both sdt:owning_party and sdt:location"
rules.rule: Shipping disposition and destination location are enforced
rules.live: Shipping with disposition active -> 202, no flag; shipping without a destination location -> 202, no flag (SHP-active, SHP-noDestLoc). A missing sourceList is rejected (400).
rules.likelyWrong: System (lenient)

rules.section: §3.2.1/§3.3.1 receiving "disposition must be active — do not use in_transit or returned"
rules.live: Receiving with in_transit -> 202; with in_progress (as in the Swagger examples) -> 202; no flag (RCV-transit, RCV-unknownDisp, SWG-rcv)
rules.likelyWrong: System (lenient). The Swagger receiving examples are wrong (in_progress, sourceList[].id, no BTT).

rules.section: TC-SPE-05 "AggregationEvent action=OBSERVE -> hard reject INVALID_ACTION 400"
rules.rule: AggregationEvent with action OBSERVE is rejected
rules.live: 202 accepted (ACT-2, both formats). INVALID_ACTION is never emitted.
rules.likelyWrong: System bug

rules.section: TC-SPE-06 "bizStep=commissioning + disposition=in_transit -> hard reject INVALID_DISPOSITION 400"
rules.live: 202 accepted with no flag (DISP-1, both formats)
rules.likelyWrong: System bug

rules.section: TC-SPE-07 OUT_OF_ORDER_EVENT; §1.2 "All EPCIS events in a message envelope must be in chronological order"
rules.live: A shipping event timed before the prior receiving -> 202, no flag (OOO). Events in a document newest-first -> 202, no flag (MULTI-order).
rules.likelyWrong: Both: the code is absent from §6.1 and the system does not check order (§6.1.3 says any order is accepted).

rules.section: §2.6.3 "eventTime must be in UTC, ending with Z"; §4.3.2 "Omitting the Z suffix will cause the event to be rejected"
rules.rule: eventTime with a +03:00 offset is rejected
rules.live: eventTime with +03:00 accepted (TIME-Z commissioning; DST-noZ destruction; both formats). No timezone at all -> 400.
rules.likelyWrong: Docs bug, most likely: the system accepts any valid ISO 8601 offset, and the guide's own §6.4 samples use +03:00.

rules.section: §2.3 "SBDH 1.3 is required for EPCIS 1.2 XML"; INVALID_SBDH; Swagger dispense "EPCIS 1.2 XML (with or without SBDH wrapper)"
rules.rule: SBDH-wrapped XML is accepted, and bad headers give INVALID_SBDH
rules.live: Every SBDH-wrapped document, including the guide's own SBDH example with a fresh event, on both the async and dispense routes -> 400 INVALID_XML_STRUCTURE "Missing EPCISDocument root element" (SBDH-*). XML without SBDH is accepted. INVALID_SBDH is unreachable.
rules.likelyWrong: System bug

rules.section: §6.4 reason "(short token or CBV URI accepted)"
rules.rule: The JSON-LD errorDeclaration.reason may be a CBV URI
rules.live: reason "urn:epcglobal:cbv:er:did_not_occur" in JSON-LD -> 400 INVALID_JSON_STRUCTURE "must be a short CBV token" (ED-reasonURN)
rules.likelyWrong: Docs bug: §6.4 contradicts §2.6.3, which says JSON-LD uses plain tokens, errorDeclaration.reason included.

rules.section: §6.1.1 ERROR_DECLARATION_INVALID_REASON (400)
rules.live: JSON-LD reason "oops" -> 400 INVALID_JSON_STRUCTURE; XML reason urn:example:oops -> HTTP 500 "Internal server error" (ED-reason)
rules.likelyWrong: System bug (XML 500; wrong code)

rules.section: §6.4 "When only the data is wrong, submit the error declaration and corrective event in the same capture document"; §6.3 "error declarations are not treated as duplicates"
rules.rule: incorrect_data plus corrective event in one document is accepted
rules.live: The whole document is rejected: 400 DOCUMENT_REJECTED. The corrective event (same EPC+bizStep as the original) gets 409 DUPLICATE_EVENT_PAYLOAD, so the declaration then gets ERROR_DECLARATION_CORRECTIVE_NOT_FOUND (ED-incOk, both formats).
rules.likelyWrong: System bug: payload dedupe blocks the documented correction flow, because a correction normally keeps the EPC and bizStep.

rules.section: §6.4 "correctiveEventIDs … Required when reason is incorrect_data"
rules.live: JSON-LD -> 400 MISSING_NEEDED_FIELDS; XML -> 202 with warning INCOMPLETE_ERROR_DECLARATION (ED-incNoCorr)
rules.likelyWrong: System bug: XML and JSON-LD are validated differently.

rules.section: §6.4 "This voids the original for trace and rule-engine purposes"
rules.rule: A voided commissioning no longer counts
rules.live: Packing a serial whose commissioning was voided with did_not_occur -> no UNCOMMISSIONED_CHILD; the response matches the non-voided control (ED-voidEffect vs ED-ctrl)
rules.likelyWrong: System, likely (moderate confidence; checked 12 s after the void)

rules.section: §5-6 "accepted (HTTP 201) with one or more entries in warnings[]"; TC "201 ⚠"; §6.4 table "201 — accepted"
rules.rule: Flagged events and valid error declarations return 201
rules.live: Every non-dispense event, flagged or not, including valid error declarations -> 202
rules.likelyWrong: Docs bug: 201 applies only to the dispense route.

rules.section: §6.3 warning response example; Swagger response schemas
rules.rule: Response body shape: status/statusCode/correlationId, warnings[].errorCode/eventIndex/epc/resolution; Swagger warnings = string[]; dispense 201 = status/status_code/processing_mode/timestamp
rules.live: Async: {success,message,event_ids,events_processed,warnings:[{layer,field,code,message,severity:"warning"}],processing_mode,_sandbox}. Dispense: {event_id,epcs_processed,class_level,_sandbox}
rules.likelyWrong: Docs bug (update the example and the Swagger schemas)

rules.section: §2.4 / §4.5 "stock_taking (canonical; inventory_taking also accepted)"
rules.live: JSON-LD -> 400 INVALID_JSON_STRUCTURE "bizStep must be a short CBV token"; XML (urn:epcglobal:cbv:bizstep:inventory_taking) -> HTTP 500 for all 3 roles (matrix)
rules.likelyWrong: System bug (XML 500 in particular)

rules.section: §4.4.1 Damaged and §4.4.3 Expired use bizStep inspecting and are partner events; §6.1.2 UNAUTHORIZED_INSPECTING_EVENT = "Inspecting event without PPB authority"
rules.rule: Partner damaged/expired events are not treated as regulator approvals
rules.live: Every partner inspecting/damaged and inspecting/expired event -> 202 + UNAUTHORIZED_INSPECTING_EVENT "Regulator approval event should set disposition to active (got damaged)" (matrix, chains, docexamples)
rules.likelyWrong: System bug: every inspecting event is classified as a regulator approval, so documented partner events always carry a false flag.

rules.section: §2.6 "Synchronous (Dispensing Only)"; §3.3.3 "no HTTP 202"
rules.rule: Dispensing goes only through the sync endpoint
rules.live: dispensing/dispensed POSTed to /api/integration/facility/events -> 202 ASYNC (matrix, DSP-viaEvents). The dispense validator is bypassed and different rules apply (UNKNOWN_SGTIN returned here, not on /dispense).
rules.likelyWrong: System bug: the async facility route should reject dispensing or route it to the sync path.

rules.section: §1.3 Participant responsibilities (facility: Receive, Dispense, Return Ship, Status Updates; manufacturer: no return ship / stock count)
rules.rule: Role scope is limited to the listed responsibilities
rules.live: Facility key may submit forward shipping (in_transit), destroying and stock_taking; manufacturer may submit shipping/returned (matrix)
rules.likelyWrong: Either (lenient system or incomplete docs); low impact

rules.section: §2.5 "Each API Key is scoped to a specific GLN Prefix"

rules.live: The same manufacturer key commissioned and packed under company prefixes 0614141, 0123456 and 8904179 with readPoint/bizLocation GLNs from two prefixes. All accepted; only UNKNOWN_SGLN warnings.
rules.likelyWrong: System (or the docs overstate it). The key's assigned prefix is not visible, but at most one of these prefixes can be in scope.
